# Predefined macros of TI armcl (TI ARM C/C++ Optimizing Compiler).
#
# Format (as the EDG C/C++ front end's predefined_macros.txt):
#   mode[,mode]   cannot_redefine   name   value
#
# Generated by tools/predefined-macros/generate.sh on 2026-11-20, from the
# vendor's documentation: the TI ARM Optimizing C/C++ Compiler User's Guide (SPRU186), chapter "Predefined Symbol Names". The compiler cannot be run here, so the table lists its
# documented macros, not a full -dM dump; a real installation defines more.
# C:   not documented by the vendor
# C++: not documented by the vendor
#
# __TI_COMPILER_VERSION__ encodes the version as VVRRPPPPP (21.6.0 -> 21060000); __TI_ARM__ is
# defined for Arm targets and distinguishes armcl from cl430, which defines __MSP430__.
